text:
Sam: Passing Xyvia (healthcare analytics) to CS — warm handoff. MRR $22k/mo, contract signed w/ BAA. Target go-live 2026-04-10. Needs HIPAA controls, private deploy (VPC) + Okta SSO. Sales flagged possible capacity spike on launch (expect ~800 reqs/min). Main risks: SSO config lag, cert provisioning, prod network peering timeline. cc @laura and @maria

Laura: Thanks Sam — I’ll own onboarding + enablement. Quick Q: do we have Okta admin contact + SAML metadata? Also need point for certs (ingress).

Sam: Okta admin is Priya (pri@xyvia.com). SAML metadata attached in sales notes: https://redwood.internal/docs/xyvia-sales/notes (internal). Certs will be customer-managed, they asked for step-by-step.

Maria: I’ll schedule the enablement + API walkthrough next week. Available slots Tue/Wed 10-12 PT. Will prepare a short runbook focused on PHI-safe prompts and redaction patterns.

Devon: On support side — we should pre-create tickets for known blockers. Created SUP-7891 for SSO troubleshooting and ENG-4523 for private deploy networking. DEV/ENG will need the exact CIDR ranges and peering window.

opsbot: Created ENG-4523 (private-deploy-networking) and assigned to eng-infra oncall.

Laura: TL;DR action list I’ll track: 1) Get SAML metadata from Priya + upload to our SSO portal (owner: laura, due: 2026-03-28) 2) Confirm cert workflow with customer (owner: sam, due: 2026-03-25) 3) Preflight infra (owner: devon/eng-infra, ticket ENG-4523) 4) Schedule enablement + privacy runbook (owner: maria, due: 2026-03-30) 5) Set burst capacity plan (owner: laura/ops, note: request 2x A100 dedicated, ops to confirm cost)

Sam: Note on renewal risk — customer is on a 12mo term, heavy usage expected in month 10-12; recommend early QBR planning around month 9 to ensure stickiness.

Devon: Need a quick smoke test curl for the CS team to validate token+endpoint once staging is up. Sample I’ll post here:

```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TEST_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"test PHI redaction: Patient: John Doe, ssn: 123-45-6789"}'
```

Laura: Perfect. Once staging is ready we’ll run that and verify redaction hooks. Also will run prompt evaluation set A (privacy-focused) and capture any regressions.

Maria: I’ll include a slide in enablement: "How we handle PHI, redaction, and logging" + checklist for the security review.

Sam: Customer expects a go/no-go call on 2026-04-02. Please surface any blockers by 2026-03-31.

Devon: ENG-4523 notes: need customer CIDR, IP allowlist, and preferred peering time window. I left a comment on the ticket for priya@xyvia.com.

Laura: Action owners confirmed. I’ll create a shared Confluence onboarding page and add the runbook + links to ENG/SUP tickets. Will ping this thread when done. :thumbsup:

Sam: Thanks team — happy to jump in on the cert call if needed.

opsbot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in on 2026-03-29 at 10:00 PT (auto).

Laura: Closing note — flagged potential renewal conversation as a risk tag in the account (renewal-risk: medium). Will include health metrics in the first QBR.

Sam: +1, thanks everyone.
